scripts.build: pnpm --filter @writer-agent/contracts build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && pnpm build:ssr
scripts.lint: eslint src worker vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts e2e
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test --config playwright.config.ts && pnpm -w build:api:go && pnpm -w build:agent:worker && node e2e/run-api-e2e.mjs && node e2e/run-review-e2e.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.auth.config.ts && pnpm test:public && pnpm test:management && pnpm test:knowledge && pnpm test:thinking && pnpm test:creative
scripts.test:seo:performance: VITE_STORY2U_PUBLIC_SITE=true VITE_WRITER_AGENT_MODE=api pnpm build && node scripts/measure-public-performance.mjs
scripts.test:knowledge: pnpm -w build:api:go && pnpm -w build:agent:worker && playwright test --config playwright.knowledge.config.ts
scripts.test:thinking: pnpm -w build:api:go && pnpm -w build:agent && node scripts/test-thinking-funnel.mjs
